newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bayer says foreign units to fuel growth.
newsitem.headline: Bayer says foreign units to fuel growth.

text.p: German chemicals and drugs group Bayer AG said on Tuesday that the Americas and Asia will continue to be the main regions fuelling growth as the sluggish German economy showed few signs of improving soon.

"For Germany we do not look for a marked improvement in the economic situation and so the engine for growth will continue to come, as it has in the first nine months of this year, from the North American, Latin American and Asian regions," Bayer chief executive Manfred Schneider told a news conference.

In the first nine months of the year domestic sales rose only 2.7 percent while international sales jumped 10.1 percent, with North American sales posting the strongest increase of 19.4 percent to 9.1 billion marks.
Sales in Latin America jumped 16.6 percent to 2.04 billion marks while sales in Asia climbed 1.2 percent to 4.23 billion.
Europe, however, remains Bayer's largest single market with sales of 21.2 billion marks in the first nine months of the year, which marks a 3.4 percent rise from year-ago levels.
